title: The Rain, 2023
logline: The twenty-sixth January. The sill, the rain, the three jars — and a fourth now, small, holding the chewed nib handle from the box in 2014. The pup's, kept.

panels.composition: The casement window in January rain from inside, three jars on the sill and a fourth, smaller, holding a single chewed wooden nib handle; the pup asleep in the bed below.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage window in January rain from inside with three jars on the sill and a fourth small jar holding a single chewed wooden pen handle, a small three-legged dog asleep in a bed below, no words
image.notes: The nib from dw_2014-12-21 / 12-22. The fourth jar joins the sill inventory (objects.md).

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A fourth jar: the chewed nib.
